subtopics.title: Organic Molecules — Naming, Isomers and Properties

questions.question: A five-carbon chain with a hydroxyl on carbon 2 and a methyl on carbon 4 is named:
Propanal and propanone (both C₃H₆O) are examples of:
options: Functional isomers — same formula, different functional group

questions.question: Boiling point climbs through a homologous series because longer chains have:
options: Stronger induced dipole forces between larger molecules

questions.question: Branching LOWERS the boiling point of an alkane because it:
options: Shrinks the contact surface, weakening the intermolecular forces

questions.question: A double bond is CONSUMED during a reaction. The type is:
But-1-ene + HBr gives 2-bromobutane as the MAJOR product because hydrogen adds to:
options: The carbon already holding more hydrogens
The carbon with the fewest hydrogens

questions.question: The bromine water test identifies an unsaturated compound because it:
options: Decolourises the bromine water quickly through addition

questions.question: Propanoic acid warmed with methanol over concentrated sulfuric acid gives:
options: Methyl propanoate and water — alcohol first, acid second in the name

questions.question: Raising the temperature increases the rate MAINLY because:
options: The fraction of particles above the activation energy grows

questions.question: A catalyst raises the rate by:
options: Shifting the Maxwell-Boltzmann curve to the right
Providing an alternative path of lower activation energy, itself unconsumed

questions.question: H₂ + Br₂ ⇌ 2HBr: 0,8 mol each in 4 dm³, 0,2 mol H₂ left at equilibrium. Kc = (0,3)²/(0,05 × 0,05) =
The ONLY disturbance that changes the value of Kc is:
In the Lowry-Brønsted picture, an acid is:
A 0,001 mol·dm⁻³ NaOH solution has a pH of:
Strong versus concentrated: a STRONG acid is one that:
options: Has many moles dissolved per cubic decimetre
Ionises completely — strength is the fraction ionised

subtopics.title: Carbon Families and the Reaction Compass

questions.question: In the name-tag picture, the SURNAME of an organic molecule is:
options: The longest chain — meth, eth, prop, but and onward

questions.question: A saturated molecule is a full bus, so its only move is:
options: Substitution — one passenger off, one on

questions.question: Any molecule holding an OH group boils far above its size class because of:
options: Hydrogen bonding — the superglue of intermolecular forces

subtopics.title: The Seesaw and the Stubborn Opponent

questions.question: At equilibrium, the quantities that are EQUAL are the:
options: Rates of the forward and reverse reactions — almost never the amounts

questions.question: Squeezing a gaseous equilibrium into less space makes the system favour:
options: The side with fewer gas molecules
The side with more gas molecules

questions.question: Every Le Chatelier explain-answer follows three sentences:
options: Disturbance, opposing reaction, new position with its result

questions.question: Pouring extra reactant into an equilibrium mixture leaves Kc:
options: Unchanged — only temperature reprograms the constant

subtopics.title: One Machine, Two Directions — and the Last Audit

questions.question: In BOTH the galvanic and electrolytic cell:
options: Oxidation happens at the anode, reduction at the cathode
The anode swaps with each cell

questions.question: The electrolytic cell differs from the galvanic cell because it:
options: Uses electrical energy to force a non-spontaneous reaction

questions.question: Whatever the cell, the electrode with electrons flowing OUT of it into the wire is:
A positive cell emf, E°cathode − E°anode, tells you the:
options: Reaction is spontaneous — forward gear works on its own
